name: sg-semicon-expansion-plugin
description: SBF-aligned US market-entry prospecting for Singapore semiconductor-supply-chain SMEs using three review-gated skills.

interface.shortDescription: Map SME capabilities to practical US entry routes.
interface.longDescription: Supports SBF and Singapore semiconductor-supply-chain SMEs through a three-step, review-gated workflow: assess SME capabilities and optional existing-customer context, confirm the search vocabulary before discovering new commercial prospects and ecosystem connectors across priority US clusters, then qualify the strongest candidates and recommend practical SBF support actions.
defaultPrompt: Use $map-sme-capability for [SME website or company profile].
